title: BazarDor
tagline: Today's grocery prices at a glance, in Bangla
description: A Bangla web app that shows the latest prices of everyday grocery items with the daily percentage change, so people can quickly see what became cheaper or costlier. The site notes that all prices are estimates. Product detail pages need a free account (sign up with email, Google or GitHub).
features: Today's price per kg, litre or dozen
Daily increase or decrease in percent
Category filtering and price sorting (low to high, high to low)
BetterAuth sign-up and login (email, Google, GitHub), a profile page, and protected product detail pages with minimum, maximum and average prices
challenges: Showing many products and daily changes clearly in a Bangla interface
Protecting product detail pages and managing login sessions with BetterAuth
improvements: Connect a real, regularly updated price data source

title: FitLog
description: A dark, responsive gym companion where users browse exercises, read instructions, build a daily plan and track totals for exercises, minutes and calories.
features: Library of 12 exercises with category, equipment, duration, calories and rating
Detail page for each exercise with sets, reps and a 4-step guide
Daily plan capped at 5 exercises, plus a Save for Later list
Live summary cards, sorting, Mark as Done and remove actions
Plans saved in LocalStorage; custom 404 page
challenges: Real-time sorting by duration, calories and rating
Keeping the plan and saved list after page reload with LocalStorage
improvements: Custom exercises and a larger library

title: DevStack
tagline: Explore technologies and build your own tech stack
description: A React app where developers explore software technologies and assemble a custom tech stack, with instant feedback for every action.
features: Loads technologies from a JSON file with a loading state
Add technologies to your stack with duplicate prevention
Toast notifications and a live selected count
challenges: Keeping the stack list, duplicate checks and notifications in sync with state
Loading data on mount without blocking the first render
improvements: Save the stack in LocalStorage or an account
Export or share the finished stack
